issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_brick_wall, vine, cornflower, iron_bars, red_wall_banner, moss_carpet, red_banner, deepslate_tile_stairs, deepslate_tiles.

notes.roof: Steep deepslate cones with a 1-block overhang and red flags, but every ring is two identical stair layers stacked (y11-12, 13-14, 15-16), so the cones read as stepped pagoda tiers in one flat dark colour; they also sit straight on the merlons and hide them.
notes.life: Vines on the front faces, planters with poppy/cornflower at the back, moss carpet on the gate-room top.
notes.levels: The slate cones and flags make L3 unmistakable.

visual.summary: L2 plus tall deepslate-tile cones with flagpoles on both towers, a standing banner over the gate room, vines, back planters and trapdoor murder-hole covers in the passage ceiling.
problems: Cones (x 0..6 and 8..14, y 11..16): each ring is two stacked stair layers, which gives stepped tiers instead of a cone; step in every layer (stairs over full blocks) or alternate deepslate_tiles and stairs, and add a second tone (e.g. deepslate_brick trim at the eave ring y 11).
The cone eave ring at y 11 rests directly on the merlon tops (y 10) so the crenellation disappears under the roof; lift the cone one block or set it inside the merlons.
Earlier-level points still open: white_terracotta face at (6,6,7),(8,6,7) and the invisible one-row portcullis at (6..8,3,4).
Reachability: 255 of 352 reached; the 97 unreached are the cone slopes and (10,5,2). Fighting tops and gate room are reached. Fine.
